Name: Luremaster B Gone
Author: zombifier
Description:
In vanilla, Luremaster (crab pots no longer need bait) is the one profession that [b]actively makes your crab pots worse[/b], because it removes the ability to load them with Deluxe Bait (making the fish silver quality) or Wild Bait (giving you a chance to get double the fish). While the solution is, obviously, not picking Luremaster in the first place, if you have mods that allow you to 'prestige' skills like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30767]Profession Books[/url]﻿ you might run into it eventually, removing your ability to get silver quality fish forever :( .

This mod fixes that by changing Luremaster to[b] make crab pots give the bait back[/b], so you can still load them with Deluxe/Wild/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36611]Rage[/url] Bait and benefit from both free bait and bait bonuses!

[b]Installation instruction:[/b][list]
[*] Download and install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Config[/url]﻿.
[*] Unzip this mod into the game's Mods folder
[/list]
[b]Compatibility:[/b] This should be compatible with every mod, with exceptions below:[list]
[*][b]NOT [/b]compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]Walk of Life[/url], because WOL already does what this mod does, and then some. Pairs well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20054?tab=description]Vanilla Plus Professions[/url] though if you use that!
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21720]Machine Progression System[/url], however this mod will [b]NOT [/b]modify the behavior of MPS's higher tier crab pots, since they use a totally different system for bait that already doesn't take into account vanilla professions. It is extremely unlikely I will change this.
[/list]
Source: [url=https://github.com/zombifier/My_Stardew_Mods/tree/master/LuremasterBGone]https://github.com/zombifier/My_Stardew_Mods/tree/master/LuremasterBGone[/url]
